title: Premium Billing Terms for Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Coverage Tiers
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Premium Billing Terms

These terms set out, for every coverage tier of Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI), how often premiums may be billed, the day of the month a monthly premium falls due, the sources from which premiums may be paid, and whether the first premium must accompany the application.

## Terms by coverage tier

| Coverage tier | Billing frequencies offered | Monthly premium due day | Deduction from VA compensation or pension | Allotment from military retired pay | First premium must accompany the application |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 1st of the month | permitted | permitted | yes |

The terms are identical across all six tiers; moving from one tier to another changes none of them.

## The terms stated as conditions

1. **Frequencies.** Premiums are billed monthly, quarterly, semiannually or annually. No other frequency is offered.
2. **Due day.** A monthly premium falls due on day 1 of each month.
3. **VA benefit deduction.** Premiums may be deducted from VA compensation or pension.
4. **Retired-pay allotment.** Premiums may be paid by allotment from military retired pay.
5. **First premium.** The first premium must accompany the application for coverage to start.

## Points of reference

- *Is a weekly or biweekly billing frequency available on any tier?* No. The four frequencies listed are the only ones offered, on every tier.
- *On what day does a monthly premium fall due?* On the 1st of the month, on every tier.
- *Does the tier held affect whether premiums can come out of a VA compensation or pension payment, or out of military retired pay?* No. Both sources are permitted on every tier.
- *Can coverage start on an application sent without the first premium?* No. On every tier the first premium must accompany the application for coverage to start.
